arguments.command:
python -c "
import re
# Simple test
p = r'a|b'
m = re.match(p, 'b')
print('Simple:', m)

# With optional prefix
p = r'[+-]?\d+|[+-]?\.\d+'
m = re.match(p, '-.121')
print('With prefix:', m)

# More complex
p = r'[+-]?\d{1,3}\.\d+|\d*\.\d+'
m = re.match(p, '-.121')
print('Complex:', m)
"
